"Tenth edition 3000 of Magnus' all around map." Cover title of accompanying envelope: Magnus' half dollar portfolio. For the Army of the Potomac. Containing a new military map: 150 miles around Richmond and 1200 miles of southern territory in smaller circles, acknowledged for the best published, and the glorious Union packet inside . . . New York and Washington, Charles Magnus. "Dedicated to the gallant soldiers, fighting to suppress the rebellion." Description derived from published bibliography.
